requirements.title: INPUT_UNIT identifies the asterisk READ external unit
requirements.source: S16.10.2.13 p1 unit identity; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF474.
requirements.definition: INPUT_UNIT is a default integer scalar constant identifying the same processor-dependent external unit as the one identified by an asterisk in a READ statement and by a READ statement with no input/output control list.

pending.input-unit-default-integer-scalar: Import INPUT_UNIT, assert KIND(INPUT_UNIT) equals KIND(0) and RANK(INPUT_UNIT) equals 0; mutate the imported name to ERROR_UNIT.
pending.input-unit-same-stream-as-asterisk-read: Run with standard input records '11' and '22', execute READ(*,*) first and READ(INPUT_UNIT,*) second into -777 sentinels, and assert the values 11 then 22; mutate the second unit to ERROR_UNIT.

requirements.title: INPUT_UNIT is preconnected for sequential formatted input on image one in the initial team
requirements.source: S16.10.2.13 p1 image-one preconnection; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF474.
requirements.definition: INPUT_UNIT is preconnected for sequential formatted input on image one in the initial team.

pending.input-unit-image-one-initial-team-precon: In a single-image initial-team run with standard input record '37', initialize a target to -777, READ(INPUT_UNIT,*) the target, and assert value 37 with zero IOSTAT; mutate the unit to an unopened positive unit.

requirements.source: S16.10.2.13 p1 final sentence; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF474.
